title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data‑driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team‑first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail‑oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value‑selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

title: Legacy Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Strategy & Planning

Location

Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGOs and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your Profile

Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations

  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.

Legacy Development

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organising, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post‑event reporting.

Communication & Stakeholder Relations

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.

Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience

  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Johnson and Johnson is recruiting for a Senior Manager – MedTech External Warehousing Procurement in Raritan, NJ. Additional locations include the following: Jacksonville, FL; Sao Palo, Brazil; São José dos Campos, Brazil; and Bogotá, Colombia

About MedTech

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Purpose:

Within the Johnson & Johnson MedTech Supply Chain Procurement organization, the Global MedTech External Warehousing Procurement Team is responsible for building and implementing logistics solutions that develop a world-class network of best-value suppliers meeting J&J business needs of supply quality and reliability, responsiveness, cost competitiveness, and access to technology and innovation to fuel superior growth.

Reporting to the Director/Global Category Leader MedTech Warehousing Procurement, the Senior Manager – MedTech Warehousing Procurement will be responsible for leading or supporting selected regional and/or global projects across the MedTech organization as well as representing the Logistics Procurement organization in wider Enterprise or Supply Chain Procurement initiatives.

The Manager’s areas of responsibilities include:

  • Ensure procurement needs of the External Warehouse Category and MedTech Deliver are met in a timely and cost-effective manner across all Business Units as required with particular focus on North and Latin America MedTech. Support MedTech Deliver to manage business continuity with Warehouse Providers, resolve issues and concerns and communicate risks and progress updates to all stakeholders as required (including but not limited to pricing escalations).
  • Lead or support regional and/or global MedTech warehousing sourcing events in terms of aligning scope, deliverables, and RACI with the regional or global MedTech Deliver team. Sourcing event planning, execution, milestone reporting and stakeholder management in line with Warehouse Procurement policies and standards (including partnering with J&J Supplier Contracting Services and Legal for contract execution).
  • Lead or support major regional and/or global MedTech Warehousing procurement projects (for example – Warehousing Cost Benchmarking), aligning scope, deliverables, and RACI with the regional or global MedTech Deliver team. Project planning, execution, milestone reporting and stakeholder management in line with Warehouse Procurement policies and standards.
  • Lead or support MedTech Warehousing Procurement Strategy and/or MedTech Deliver portfolio initiatives based on OGSM priorities. Including but not limited to: Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) / Supplier Enabled Innovation (SEI) / Continuous Improvement initiatives; Logistics network, mode, or go-to-market changes; Logistics cost to serve initiatives; New Product or Service launches.

Contribute to delivery of core MedTech Warehousing Procurement Targets and Road Map including:

  • Delivery of annual Cost Improvement Projects (CIP), Cost Reduction, and Cost Avoidance Targets in line with Business Plan Commitments.
  • Shape the pipeline by contributing / inputting sourcing event ideas and innovation initiatives for Financial Cycles.
  • Delivery of Supply Chain procurement targets with regards to Supplier Diversity and Sustainability.
  • Maintain all associated MedTech Warehousing Portfolio Project Status reports, Resource Tracker and Cost Improvement Projects (CIP) reporting.
  • Ensure Contractual Compliance with Global Warehousing Standards and J&J Policies, e.g., zero expired contracts.
  • Compliance with local legislation and laws, supporting any related activities as required.

Qualifications:

  • At least a BA/BSc Degree in Procurement/Logistics/Supply Chain/Life Sciences (or similar) is required.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years of related experience is required.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of people management experience is required.
  • Prior work experience in a Logistics, Procurement or Sourcing environment with thorough understanding of logistics operations – both warehousing and transportation services is required.
  • Knowledge of healthcare and/or logistics industry / logistics service providers is preferred.
  • Strong Leadership, Influencing, Collaboration and Communication/Presentation skills are required.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and facilitate coordination of large matrixed and/or virtual teams.
  • Strong analytical and data management skills. Highly proficient in Excel/Knowledge or Sourcing Tools.
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) with excellent communication & negotiation skills (written & verbal).

  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Core
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring a technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.

This is an opportunity for a technical leader passionate about open‑source software, Linux, containers, security, and the developer experience, to shape the future of Linux from the smallest systems up to desktops. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next‑generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an engineering manager, you’ll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC‑V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap, and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

  • Building and leading a distributed team of engineers through hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development
  • Demonstrating sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Coaching and mentoring team members with hands‑on career development
  • Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organization

What we are looking for in you

  • Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development
  • Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell
  • A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core
  • Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC‑V
  • Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Sobre o Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Planejar, implementar e monitorar a distribuição de medicamentos, produtos e materiais nas diversas unidades do hospital, orientando sobre dados técnicos, tais como: dosagem, fórmula farmacêutica, composição química, substitutos etc; produzir; executar a guardar e controlar a distribuição de medicamentos; realizar controle diário dos estoques.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde.

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Escala: 12H trabalhadas x 60H de descanso
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
Overview

O que buscamos? Buscamos um profissional de Infraestrutura de TI, capaz de administrar e evoluir ambientes on-premises e em nuvem, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos serviços, com sólida base em Windows, Linux, redes, virtualização e segurança, bem como interesse em automação, padronização e boas práticas, boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa apoiando a modernização contínua da infraestrutura e o crescimento do negócio.

Atribuições Principais

  • Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
  • Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
  • Criar políticas de backup e segurança;
  • Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
  • Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
  • Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
  • Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
  • Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.

Requisitos

  • Administração de ambientes Windows Server, incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat), com experiência em gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
  • Domínio de protocolos de rede, incluindo TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
  • Conhecimento em hardware de rede, com configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
  • Experiência na configuração e suporte a serviços de rede, como VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, incluindo gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
  • Conhecimento em virtualização, utilizando ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
  • Experiência em storage, com gerenciamento de ambientes NAS e SAN, protocolos iSCSI e Fibre Channel, além da gestão de LUNs.
  • Configuração e administração de firewalls, como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
  • Implementação e gestão de rotinas de backup, políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes, utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento básico em Infrastructure as Code (IaC), com utilização de ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible.
  • Noções de containers, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script, como PowerShell ou Python, para automação de tarefas rotineiras.

Híbrido no Rio de Janeiro/RJ

title: Suporte ao Coordenador Médico
description:
Resumo

Como é ser um Coordenador Médico de Suporte em MSF?

Você será responsável por apoiar o Coordenador Médico em tarefas administrativas e operacionais, contribuindo para uma gestão eficiente dos programas, fortalecendo a relação com autoridades e garantindo que as atividades sigam os protocolos da MSF. Seu trabalho será essencial para assegurar cuidados médicos de qualidade e melhorar a saúde da população atendida.

Responsabilidades

  • Saúde do Staff: manter atualizada a política nacional de saúde do staff, identificar e validar serviços de saúde de qualidade, elaborar POPs e diretrizes, e acompanhar casos individuais, garantindo acesso adequado aos serviços, bem como a coleta e arquivamento apropriado das informações médicas.
  • Gestão da Informação e Registros: assegurar que toda a documentação contendo informações médicas seja corretamente arquivada, em conformidade com princípios de confidencialidade e proteção de dados.
  • Preparação e Resposta a Emergências: apoiar o monitoramento de dados epidemiológicos, conduzir análises de situação com base em informações disponíveis e/ou avaliações de campo, contribuir para a atualização do plano de preparação e resposta a emergências e, quando necessário, participar de respostas de emergência realizando atividades clínicas em campo.
  • Apoio Técnico ao Projeto: oferecer suporte técnico remoto ao projeto com foco na tuberculose no sistema prisional, orientando a implementação de ferramentas técnicas da MSF, apoiando a análise de dados e contribuindo para o monitoramento e a avaliação da qualidade do cuidado.
  • Advocacy e Articulação Institucional: apoiar a elaboração de relatórios médicos para fins de advocacy, identificar atores estratégicos em coordenação com o Departamento de Advocacy e acompanhar o/a Coordenador(a) Médico(a) em reuniões institucionais com o SUS e outras organizações, quando solicitado.

Dia a dia

Como é o dia a dia da posição?

Requisitos

  • Diploma em Medicina e Registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Formação ou experiência em medicina tropical e/ou saúde pública é um diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia com MSF e/ou outra ONG é um diferencial, assim como experiência de trabalho no SUS.
  • Experiência em contexto de emergência é um diferencial.
  • Fluência em português; inglês é um diferencial.

Competências necessárias

  • Compromisso em alcançar objetivos com excelência.
  • Capacidade de analisar situações e encontrar soluções eficazes.
  • Habilidade para dialogar, construir acordos e representar a organização com profissionalismo.
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças, ajustando prioridades, horários e tarefas conforme as necessidades do contexto.

Princípios e Cultura de Salvaguarda

A MSF busca pessoas comprometidas com uma cultura de salvaguarda, promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e acolhedor para todas. Valorizamos profundamente a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações. Candidaturas alinhadas a esses valores serão altamente consideradas.

title: Quality Data Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Introduction

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This position is for talented and experienced Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, volume, and accuracy of data across on‑prem and cloud environments. You will validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using IDMC, collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, results, and findings in a structured and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.

description:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development/test technologies, tools, and processes

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

title: Lead Thumbnail Designer
description:
As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you'llbuild and develop a team of 5-10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll-stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America's top real estate leaders. This is aplayer-coach leadership role where you'll spend 60-80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20-40% hands-on designing complex projects.

You'llown design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured not by how many thumbnailsyou design, but by how wellyour team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success.

This role is perfect for someone wholoves developing designers as much as designing itself - someone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, this isn't the right fit.

Team Leadership & Development (50-70% of role)

  • Directly manage 5-8 thumbnail designers conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill development and performance
  • Lead bi-weekly team design reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new designer hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for design team members
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with designers through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Conduct skip-level meetings with junior designers to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Creative Excellence & Standards (20-30% of role)

  • Design 15-30 high-impact thumbnails per month for VIP clients and complex projects
  • Own and evolve agency-wide creative quality standards, brand guidelines, and style guides
  • Establish QA processes that maintain 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and performance analysis across the entire client portfolio
  • Serve as final creative approval for all thumbnails before client delivery

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical is a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business. This role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large, complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.

You will be managing projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

Responsibilities

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What we are looking for in you

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação

Laudo médico válido e carimbado por médico especialista.

title: Software Developer
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test, and deliver high-quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross-functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team members in development/test technologies, tools, and processes.
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related field.
  • Expertise in software engineering.
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software.
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such as K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka).
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS.
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI frameworks.
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design.
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services.
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms, and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI).
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators).
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax.
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards).

description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets are provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where/if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

Your profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência com CEDTEA, para atender crianças em Reabilitação Intelectual;

Additional information

Local: Praça Seca

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

Para compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital da Maternidade Paulino Werneck. Na função de Técnico de Enfermagem-CC, desempenhando as seguintes funções:

  • Incentiva a proteção e promoção do aleitamento materno, cuidado integral individual e humanizado ao cliente e família.
  • Prestar assistência de acordo com as metas internacionais de segurança do paciente, práticas de humanização, normas e rotinas institucionais.
  • Exerce atividades de organização setorial, controle de equipamentos, transporte interno de pacientes e/ou materiais biológicos, limpezas concorrentes e terminais.
  • Cumpre normas de apresentação pessoal, comunicação cordial e empática, mantém comportamento ético-profissional, participa de treinamentos e programas de atualização e aplica os conhecimentos adquiridos.

  • Avalia antecipadamente a programação cirúrgica, assegurando a disponibilidade de todo o material cirúrgico necessário, verifica o estoque de material esterilizado e monitora as datas de esterilização.
  • Recebe e orienta pacientes e acompanhantes na admissão, explicando a rotina da unidade; prepara a Sala de Operação com os recursos necessários.

title: Senior Director Cybersecurity
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will oversee and enhance the university's cybersecurity program within a sophisticated hybrid IT environment. This position combines visionary leadership typical of a cybersecurity executive with extensive technical expertise similar to that of a Security Architect and Engineer. The Senior Director will have primary accountability for securing the university's systems, applications, networks, and data, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and guiding technical teams in initiatives focused on threat prevention and mitigation.

Supervisory Authority

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will supervise a team of cybersecurity professionals, including managers, engineers, and analysts. This position holds the authority to make decisions regarding hiring, training, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions within the cybersecurity department.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students and staff of the department and University and Howard University Hospital CIO. External contacts include vendors, consultants, investigators, auditors, etc. Collaborate closely with the Chief Audit and Compliance Officer.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute a university-wide cybersecurity strategy that aligns with Howard University’s goals and emerging threat landscapes
  • Lead cross-functional cybersecurity governance initiatives, partnering with senior academic and administrative leaders to promote a security-first culture
  • Design, implement, and continuously evolve a secure infrastructure architecture across hybrid environments (on-premises and Azure cloud), including identity management (Entra ID), network segmentation, Zero Trust, and secure access
  • Evaluate and select enterprise-class security solutions: firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel), endpoint detection and response (EDR), encryption, and data loss prevention (DLP)
  • Conduct architectural risk analysis, threat modeling, and develop mitigation strategies for new and existing systems and applications
  • Ensure identity and access management (IAM) policies align with least privilege and role-based access control principles
  • Oversee real-time security monitoring, incident detection, and coordinated incident response efforts, utilizing SIEM and SOAR platforms
  • Drive security assessments, penetration tests, and red/blue team exercises to proactively identify and resolve vulnerabilities
  • Manage vulnerability management programs and ensure timely patch management across all systems
  • Maintain and test business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) plans related to information security incidents
  • Coordinate with other departments to integrate cybersecurity measures into business processes
  • Monitor and analyze security metrics to provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Stay informed about the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies

Core Competencies

Expert experience in the following:

  • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
  • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, RAIDUS PS, CAs
  • Bare metal servers and data center configurations
  • Falcon Crowdstrike
  • Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
  • Hybrid cloud integrations
  • Authentication protocols
  • Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
  • Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper-V).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE
  • Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations
  • Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security
  • Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams in promoting a culture of compliance and cybersecurity accountability across the enterprise.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity policies, controls, and compliance frameworks within complex IT environments.
  • Strong experience with cybersecurity risk management processes, including risk assessments, business impact analyses (BIAs), and control mapping.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in computer science/ Information Technology with a security concentration and a Master’s degree in business administration is highly desirable. Industry certifications in cybersecurity are preferred and 10 to 15 years of experience in information security. Minimum three years’ experience working with firewall, vulnerability scanning, intrusion detection products and authentication technologies and three years of experience with network security, incident response, auditing, intrusion detection, forensics, vulnerability assessments, and/or analytic tools; or equivalent combination of education and experience. One or more of the following: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CGEIT, CRISC, and, or other security certification.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$160,000-$170,000

title: Psicopedagogo(a) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Overview

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes, que utiliza as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e ancorada na cultura vibrante em que se encontra. Trabalhará junto de uma equipe de mais de 13.000 colaboradores em instalações de última geração, ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor, com foco em desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira e mobilidade dentro do grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo, e em pensar nas melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

Responsabilidades

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

Declaração de Salvaguarda

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperamos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. title: Manager, Volunteer Operations
description:
Manager, Volunteer Operations

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities. In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability. Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities. We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time‑management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on‑site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Purpose

  • As Material Controller, your core responsibility is to manage and maintain the flow of materials required for projects and for the operations. Your role is crucial in ensuring the efficient and effective management of materials and inventory to support uninterrupted project and operations’ execution. This role requires a strong understanding of supply chain management, inventory control, and coordination with multiple departments to support project timelines and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory Management: You maintain and lead accurate counting and records of material in stock. You oversee material handling, storage, and preservation to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration of materials. You ensure that the storage areas are kept clean and organized.
  • Material Movement: You keep records of the in and out stock movements. You initiate, treat and coordinate the demand of transfer and move of material between storage locations. You handle the distribution of materials, supplies, and equipment based on incoming requests and orders.
  • Coordination: You maintain good communication with the yard, the warehouse or cargo teams with regards to equipment that requires additional coordination from them.
  • Documentation: You maintain and lead the maintenance of comprehensive material records, including receipts, issuances, and transfers, and generate/oversee reports for management and audit purposes.
  • Compliance: You ensure adherence to relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations in all material-related activities.
  • Material Planning: You track material consumption, and you collaborate with Projects, Maintenance and Supply Chain teams to support the material requirement forecast and to develop effective material planning strategies. You support the identification of potential material shortages, bottlenecks, and supply chain risks. You support the implementation of proactive measures to mitigate risks and develop contingency plans to address unexpected challenges.
  • Material Replenishment: If you are involved in the material replenishment process, you initiate the demand and the replenishment tasks. You coordinate replenishment or material transfer processes to avoid shortages and surplus.
  • Inspection and material Quality Control: If you are involved in the material reception process, you verify and lead the verification of the quality and specifications of incoming materials. You conduct and lead inspections and address any discrepancies or non-compliance issues.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Stock Management, Supply chain, or Logistics Management.

  • Understanding of the procurement processes.

title: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people - people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. Ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

The Technology Stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands‑on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy‑focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

We are looking for a self-starter with exceptional business acumen who can navigate complex stakeholder environments. You should be comfortable operating independently while collaborating across teams, possess strong analytical capabilities, and demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for the intersection of sports, technology, and finance. Your ability to identify creative partnership opportunities and execute them will be critical to success in this role.

Due to the global scope of Chiliz, this role requires fluency in both English and Portuguese. Please submit your CV in English.
